sloka: दीप्त जिह्वो महादंष्ट्रः तीक्ष्ण शृंगो महाबलः ।व्यचरन् दंडाकारण्यम् मांस भक्षो महामृगः ॥३-३९-३॥
transliteration: dīpta jihvo mahādaṁṣṭraḥ tīkṣṇa śṛṁgo mahābalaḥ ।vyacaran daṁḍākāraṇyam māṁsa bhakṣo mahāmṛgaḥ ॥3-39-3॥

translations.english: I wandered in Dandaka forest in the form of a huge animal with a big and strong body, a flaming red tongue and sharp teeth feeding on flesh.
